meta.title: DevStash - Store Smarter. Build Faster.
meta.description: One fast, searchable hub for your code snippets, AI prompts, commands, notes, files, images and links.

hero.lead: Your snippets, prompts, commands, and notes are scattered across Notion, GitHub, Slack, and a dozen browser tabs. DevStash brings them all into one fast, searchable hub.

preview.label: DevStash dashboard with a sidebar of item types and a grid of item cards

features.title: Everything You Need, One Place
features.lead: Stop switching between tools. DevStash keeps your developer resources organized and searchable.

snippets.title: Code Snippets
snippets.text: Save reusable code with syntax highlighting and copy it in one click.

prompts.title: AI Prompts
prompts.text: Keep your best prompts in one library, ready for any model.

search.title: Instant Search
search.text: Search content, tags, titles and types. Press ⌘K from anywhere.

commands.title: Commands
commands.text: Your most-used terminal commands, out of bash history.

files.title: Files & Docs
files.text: Keep project files, images and docs beside your code.

collections.title: Collections
collections.text: Group mixed items by project, topic or workflow.

ai.title: AI-Powered Productivity
ai.lead: Let AI handle the busywork so you can focus on building.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.lead: Start free. Upgrade when you need more power.
